description: Months and interest to clear a credit card balance with a fixed monthly payment, compared with adding an extra monthly payment. A payment that never clears the balance returns null months and interest. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive credit card payoff calculator.

extra_payment.description: Extra payment added each month in USD; default 0.

name: calculate_credit_card_payoff
